title: GS21 exposure LINEAR IN LEVERAGE with a continuous firm-level debt capacity: coupon drawn at birth from [0.1, 0.9] (gs_fixcs 2), exposure 0.1 b~, one type, price 2.5 (the 3a control on leverage)
question: Is an exposure monotone in leverage priced linearly through the leverage characteristic, as the productivity version (gvyz10) is through profitability?
notes:
WHY (2026-11-07). Section 3 uses one firm state per model in 3a, 3b and 3c; GS21's is leverage. This is the 3a control: the exposure is 0.1 b~, linear in the standardized continuous coupon (gs_bzc 1, gs_bzq 0), one type, no bound, no compensation.
